title: EXP-028 — Button Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: On one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ButtonCaptionLab01`, use the replay-verified creation and native Button procedures to create exactly one Button named `FX_ButtonCaption01`, record its untouched Caption baseline and exact property-grid Type label, change only the Button Caption to exactly `Button Caption Recovery`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save, exactly one ordinary target Form-tab close, and exactly one same-Designer Form-menu recent-forms reopen, then verify that the same scoped Form recovers the same Button Name, identical Type label, and exact Caption. Treat the result only as UI-level recovery across this ordinary close/reopen workflow; do not claim Forms-database durability, cache eviction, unload behavior, or behavior of other component properties/types.

Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 with Save Template visibly unchecked
Capture an untouched clean post-creation Form baseline without claiming complete component cardinality
Place exactly one native Toolbox Button using the verified placement procedure
Assign component Name exactly FX_ButtonCaption01 using the verified Name-edit procedure
Record authoritative pre-Caption component Name, exact visible property-grid Type label, and exact Caption baseline
Change only the Button Caption to exactly Button Caption Recovery
Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save and verify clean return with Name, Type, and Caption unchanged
Close FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control
Reopen FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 exactly once through the same Designer's Form-menu recent-forms entry
Post-reopen verify exact Form identity by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName and exact recovered component Name + Type + Caption
Final read-only Select Form exactly-one target proof, controlled-action reconciliation, and repository-confinement audit
Write evidence only under evidence/EXP-028/ and the EXP-028 experiment record

acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, evidence proves a usable live workflow in User scope, preserves inherited state untouched, shows a working known-existing Select Form positive control with Case Sensitive unchecked, and proves zero case-insensitive Name matches for FX_ButtonCaptionLab01.

Evidence proves exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 was created through the fresh-dialog Classic/BuildFromScratch procedure with Save Template visibly unchecked, and the loaded Form identity is Name=FX_ButtonCaptionLab01, ScopeType=User, ScopeName=<current user>.

Before Caption mutation, evidence proves the target Form is clean and shows exactly one newly placed native Button identified authoritatively as Name=FX_ButtonCaption01, records its exact visible property-grid Type label, and records its exact untouched Caption baseline; no unrelated property mutation is evidenced.

Evidence proves only the Button Caption changed from the recorded baseline to exactly `Button Caption Recovery`, while authoritative Name remains FX_ButtonCaption01 and Type remains identical to AC-3; the Form is dirty and no ordinary Save has yet occurred.

Exactly one ordinary Designer Save is evidenced; afterward the target is clean and authoritative component Name=FX_ButtonCaption01, Type equals AC-3, and Caption equals exactly `Button Caption Recovery`.

Exactly one ordinary target Form-tab close is evidenced; the target tab is gone, no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt appears, no explicit unload occurs, and the same Designer client remains active.

Exactly one reopen through the same Designer's Form-menu recent-forms entry is evidenced; the reopened Form has Name=FX_ButtonCaptionLab01, ScopeType=User, matching ScopeName, clean state, and the recovered Button reports authoritative Name=FX_ButtonCaption01, Type exactly equal to AC-3, and Caption exactly `Button Caption Recovery`. If the recent-forms entry is unavailable or session establishment is required after mutation, stop blocked.

Final read-only audit shows exactly one case-insensitive Select Form Name match for FX_ButtonCaptionLab01, reconciles exactly one Form creation, one Button creation, one Name assignment, one Caption assignment, one ordinary Save, one target close, and one recent-forms reopen, and proves experiment-authored repository changes are confined to the EXP-028 record and evidence/EXP-028/. The resulting finding may be classified observed only; replay verification requires a later independent replay.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261007-173418-s6vM. Rationale: EXP-027-R2 has now replay-verified the self-contained User-scope workflow for creating one classic BuildFromScratch Form, placing one native Button, saving once, closing the Form tab once, and reopening it through the same Designer's recent-forms route while recovering the Button's Name and Type. The smallest adjacent unanswered metadata question is whether a Button Caption, which is a distinct component property class, recovers across that same weak close/reopen boundary. EXP-018 was blocked before Form creation at an obsolete wizard-selection prerequisite, while the later fresh-dialog Classic/BuildFromScratch sequence and Button placement procedure are now independently replay-verified; this proposal therefore uses those documented procedures as a new experiment rather than attempting to repair EXP-018. EXP-020 has unknown status and is not relied upon.
